title: Meta annual R&D spending
definition: Research and development operating expense reported on Meta Platforms, Inc.'s Consolidated Statements of Income.

sources.title: Form 8-K Exhibit 99.1: Meta Reports Fourth Quarter and Full Year 2025 Results

points.evidence: Consolidated Statements of Income, 'Research and development', Twelve Months Ended December 31, 2024: $43,873 million.
Consolidated Statements of Income, 'Research and development', Twelve Months Ended December 31, 2025: $57,372 million.
